title: Dependency license auditor (CLI)
scenario: Missing license: the most relevant candidate repository has no license on record, so it must be marked review_required, not approved for reuse.
idea: A command line tool that scans my project's dependencies and tells me which licenses they use and which ones break our company policy.

brief.problem: Developers cannot easily see which dependency licenses a project pulls in, or whether any break a stated policy.
brief.users: Developers and tech leads checking a repository before release.

must_have.text: Scan a project and list every dependency with its license
Compare the result with a configurable allow/deny policy
Exit with a non-zero code when the policy is broken, for use in CI

nice_to_have.text: Support more than one package ecosystem

constraints.privacy: Must run without uploading the dependency list anywhere

assumptions.text: Python and JavaScript projects are the first targets

unknowns: What the company policy actually allows
